We're reconciling our June invoices and flagged INV-20250601 as overdue. Our AP team says the VAT line on the PDF doesn't match the VAT number we have on file for Acorn EU operations — they see a UK VAT rate but our subsidiary is registered in Ireland. Could you confirm the tax treatment and send the VAT certificate you used? We can process once that's squared away.

- We approve the two-installment payment plan for INV-20250601-R (50% due 2025-07-07, 50% due 2025-07-21).
